summary.tagline: A historic railway trail and riverside retreat within the Tamar Valley National Landscape.
summary.best_season: Spring and Summer are recommended for walking the riverside trails.
summary.seo_title: Visiting Wacker Quay and Antony Village

travel.headline: Public Access to River Lynher at Wacker Quay
travel.reservation: Access to Wacker Quay and the River Lynher is free to the public and managed by the Tamar Community Trust. No entry permits are required for the woodland trail or riverside views, though visitors should check official Tamar Valley National Landscape updates for seasonal maintenance or safety guidance.

days.title: Riverside Heritage and Railway Trails

stops.name: Wacker Quay
stops.detail: Explore the historic railway remains including turntables and an engine house while enjoying views of the River Lynher. Follow the level railway bed trail toward Antony village to see evocative industrial sidings and local nature.

days.driving: Allow 10 minutes from Antony via A374; conditions vary.
days.note: The walkway follows a level railway bed, providing an easy connecting route to the village without a car.

intel.title: Wacker Quay Parking
intel.text: Free car parking is available on-site, allowing visitors to enjoy nature and river views directly from their vehicles. The lot is located approximately two miles west of Antony village.

intel.title: Mobile Coverage Gap
intel.text: Official evidence does not state the availability of cellular signal at Wacker Quay. Visitors should download self-guided walk leaflets and maps before departing Antony village.

intel.title: Local Services
intel.text: Fuel and supplies are not listed for the Quay itself; travelers should verify stations in Torpoint or Trerulefoot before arrival. The site is primarily a nature spot managed by volunteers.

intel.title: Trail Pace
intel.text: The walk between the quay and Antony village uses a cleared walkway along a level railway bed. Allow for a relaxed pace to view the historic railway incline and illustrated markers.

intel.title: Road Connectivity
intel.text: Wacker Quay is clearly signposted from the main A374 road. The route is accessible between Torpoint and Trerulefoot for those arriving by vehicle.

plan.arrival: Collect supplies in Torpoint before heading west on the A374 toward the River Lynher. Look for the Wacker Quay signage to access the parking area and trailheads.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for the A374; check local rental restrictions for narrow rural access roads.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset over the River Lynher provides scenic lighting for the railway trail, though visibility on woodland paths decreases quickly.
